mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; rizatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist and tranylcypromine is an irreversible MAOI, creating risk for serotonin syndrome.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use rizatriptan with tranylcypromine or within 14 days of MAOI discontinuation; allow 5 half-lives between rizatriptan discontinuation and MAOI initiation.
